heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Can you integrate flight and hotel providers?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate booking APIs and aggregators.

items.question: Can the app work offline?
items.answer: Yes. Maps, itineraries and tickets can be available offline.

items.question: Can you build both an app and a website?
items.answer: Yes. We deliver web and mobile experiences together.

items.question: How long does travel app development take?
items.answer: A launch-ready first version takes 8 to 12 weeks, while a full platform with customer, provider and admin apps takes 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
